execution_policy_source.description:
Empty retains pre-existing profile/API behavior. New UI configurations use
global defaults; override opts into an explicit per-profile policy.

recovery_mode.description:
Empty preserves the historical Auto GPU-to-CPU behavior. Explicit fixed
and stage_management modes never change device, precision, or context.

reuse_checkpoints.description:
Nil means exact-compatible checkpoint reuse is enabled. False requests
new artifacts; it never disables durable persistence.

transcription_context.description:
Nil context fields inherit the requesting user's defaults when a run is
queued. A pointer to an empty string explicitly disables that default.

start_word_index.description: Use gte=0 so 0 is valid (first word/time); avoid 'required' which fails for zero values

hf_token.description: Write-only: omitted/null preserves the saved token; an empty string clears it.

quote.description: The exact quoted text chosen by the user

start_time.description: Time bounds for the selection (in seconds)

start_word_index.description: Indexed selection into transcript by word positions
